main.title: Main researcher
main.scope_notice: This panel belongs to the displayed project and workflow instance. Directions enter its native research queue and use its existing finite research allowance.
main.lifetime: Closing this panel or browser does not stop PMRS. Background work continues while its backend is running.
main.direction: Direction or question for the main researcher
main.direction_help: State the scientific question, objection or direction in your own words. The main researcher must account for it with an answer or actual work. Saving does not prove that a model has started. Paused work and exhausted allowance remain visible.
main.choose_instance: Choose the exact workflow instance first.
main.read_error: Could not refresh native state. The original submission is retained; this refresh did not resubmit it.
main.read_only: Opening, refreshing and reading this panel make no model calls.
main.empty_directions: No directions have been submitted for this instance.
main.empty_routes: No research routes have been recorded yet.
main.no_proposal: The main researcher has not yet recorded a progress proposal.
main.no_incidents: No incidents are recorded for this instance.
main.search_query: Search native records and exact sources
main.report_help: This directly authorizes native report revision of the selected exact body. Earlier effective requirements remain in force. Unselected sections are preserved. Report calls use a separate finite allowance; leave blank to use an existing allowance. Revision does not resume paused research.
main.revision_wait: Wait for the exact report revision to load.
main.select_sections: Choose at least one exact section.
main.usage_help: Unknown totals stay unknown. Cached and reasoning tokens are included categories. Synthetic requests are displayed separately.
main.communication_help: Delivered content is task input. A response that may have been exposed is conservatively retained when checking independence. Messages and acknowledgements do not grant scientific support.
main.wait.PAUSED: Research is paused. The direction remains queued.
main.wait.BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: The original research allowance is exhausted.
main.wait.NO_ACTIVE_MISSION: There is no active research round.
main.wait.UNKNOWN_REQUEST: The original send outcome is UNKNOWN. Resolve it before any resend.
error.REPORT_CONTENT_STALE: The exact report body changed. Open its current version and inspect your earlier requirements before requesting a new change.
error.REPORT_REVISION_STALE: The selected report revision is no longer the current editable version. Preserved earlier PDFs remain available.
error.REPORT_REVISION_SCOPE: Choose exact listed sections or the whole report.
error.REPORT_REVISION_RANGE: The proposed revision changed content outside its permitted section range. It was not accepted; inspect the original result.
error.REPORT_BUDGET_REQUIRED: Report revision needs an applicable finite report allowance. Enter additional report calls in the exact revision form.
main.wait.NO_ACTIVE_AUTHORIZATION: There is no active research authorization.
main.worker_policy: The following defaults apply to other roles. Main researcher tasks always use the fixed configuration above.
